purpose: Original landscape backgrounds for Jobward boards

Wide 16:9 composition, highest available resolution, ideally 3840x2160. Photorealistic fine photographic detail, restrained natural colors, peaceful atmosphere, gently balanced exposure and low visual clutter. Broad quiet areas across the middle and lower frame so interface cards will remain the focal point. This is just the landscape asset: absolutely no text, letters, logos, watermark, user interface, frames, people, buildings or vehicles.
